current.text: He is 37 and recovering from a torn ACL. He will not be ready to start the season. Yahoo lists him as out (knee).
Experts expect him back in January. Christmas is the earliest likely date, and some experts allow for a return as late as February.
When he returns, expect limited minutes and no games on back-to-backs.
Golden State has 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most in the league.
The Golden State schedule is good for fantasy playoffs that end March 28.
Golden State may treat this as a gap year. The team is worried about lottery odds and may rest veterans, which puts his games after his return at more risk.
Draft him only after round 12, as a last-round IL stash. Keep him only while you have a free IL slot, and drop him once you need that slot. Taking him around round 10 is a bad pick.

durable.text: His game relies on IQ, cutting, physicality and drawing free throws, not on explosiveness.
His category value comes from FT% on solid volume, plus steals and assists for a forward. He makes few threes for his position.
He has a torn ACL in his injury history.
